explanation: The earlier record’s own cited article says what the one gave the other: “The delay allowed the Boers to construct the entrenchments which they were to defend in the Battle of Magersfontein.” `precondition-of` and not `caused`: Modder River did not produce the later battle, it bought the Boers the fortified line Magersfontein was fought against thirteen days later. `probable` rather than `consensus`, because the only source the atlas can open here is the encyclopaedia article itself (rule 22).
